note: Re-judged after the test dropped its no-notify case and gained key types. With RemoteHashAlgos set, TestRFC7427DigitalSignatureMethodIsUsed drives computeX509Auth for RSA-2048 and ECDSA on P-256, P-384 and P-521, every key type that now has a legacy method in auth_legacy.go and auth_ecdsa.go, and fails on any of methods 1, 3, 9, 10, 11 and on anything other than 14 with non-empty data, so a legacy branch leaking past the notify goes red for each key. Dropping the no-notify case is right: RFC 7427 Section 3 conditions this sentence on both ends having sent the notify, and that case belongs to RFC7427-3-4. Finding: the negative tag is entailed by the positive's == 14 assertion over the same inputs, so the pair is one assertion in two hats; it still discriminates because the requirement is a signer obligation whose only violation is Ze's own output. Untested edge: a received notify with an empty list must not fall back to a legacy method (parseHashAlgoNotify answers []uint16{}, pinned untagged by TestParseHashAlgoNotifyShort, never through computeX509Auth). Recorded discrimination breaks are whole-body panics only.
